name: Market and property data
what: Listing, comparable sale and lease, ownership and analytics data providers, plus the public sources sponsors check first.

tasks.title: Look up a property
tasks.question: Can an agent look up a property by address or parcel and get structured attributes such as size, year built and use?
tasks.full: A documented API or data service returns property attributes for an address or parcel as structured data.
tasks.partial: Only some attributes, or only through the app's search screen or a manual export.
tasks.na: The source does not describe individual properties.

tasks.title: Query comparables
tasks.question: Can an agent query sale or lease comparables with filters and get structured results?
tasks.full: A documented API or data service returns sale or lease comparables filtered by place, type, size or date.
tasks.partial: Comparables only through the app or a manual export, or without filters.
tasks.na: The source does not cover sale or lease transactions.

tasks.title: Find the owner of record
tasks.question: Can an agent get the owner of record and mailing address for a parcel as structured data?
tasks.full: A documented API or data service returns the owner of record and mailing address for a parcel.
tasks.partial: The owner name only, or only through the app's search screen.
tasks.na: The source does not describe individual properties.

tasks.title: Pull an area in bulk
tasks.question: Can an agent pull records for a whole area, such as a county, a drawn shape or a radius, in bulk?
tasks.full: A documented bulk download, bulk API or area query returns all records for an area.
tasks.partial: Area queries are capped at a small number of records, or bulk files need a separate order.
